notes: Needs a ruling: «أنه سمعه يقول أقبلت أنا وعبد الرحمن بن يسار» is a first-person narrative whose speaker (the «ه» Umayr heard) is named nowhere in the text; the route stops at عمير and the speaker is not added
«قال مسلم» is the compiler's own words, not a link
«مولى ابن عباس» is a descriptor of عمير, left out; «عبد الرحمن بن يسار» is in the story, not a link
